title: Polynomial evaluation lifts to the valuation ring with residue kernel generated by q
statement: Let K and F be fields, with a K-algebra structure on F. Let x ∈ F be transcendental over K, let q ∈ K[T] be irreducible, and let v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F. Assume that, for every f ∈ F, membership f ∈ v.toValuationSubring is equivalent to the existence of a,b ∈ K[T] such that q does not divide b and f = a(x)/b(x). Put A = v.toValuationSubring and let ρ : A → κ(v) be the canonical residue homomorphism. There exists a K-algebra homomorphism e : K[T] → A whose composite with A → F is evaluation at x and such that ker(ρ ∘ e) is the ideal generated by q.
lean_statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → ∀ q : Polynomial K, Irreducible q → ∀ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, (∀ f : F, f ∈ v.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → ∃ e : Polynomial K →ₐ[K] v.toValuationSubring, (∀ a : Polynomial K, (e a : F) = Polynomial.aeval x a) ∧ RingHom.ker ((IsLocalRing.residue v.toValuationSubring).comp e.toRingHom) = Ideal.span ({q} : Set (Polynomial K))
